title: AI Connections and Deployments: Connect Your Site to an AI Service | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Before anyone can chat with an AI assistant, search documents with AI, or hold a spoken conversation, your Orchard Core site has to reach an AI service and know which model to use for each job. The CrestApps AI module keeps that in one place: you add a connection once, add a deployment for each model, and choose the default models, so every profile and feature picks a model by name.

In this video:
• Why the provider is set up once instead of in every profile
• How connections, deployments and default deployments fit together
• Adding a connection with an endpoint and an API key
• Adding chat and embedding deployments
• Model capabilities, including reasoning effort
• Choosing the default chat, utility and embedding models
• Which capability each feature needs

chapters.title: Match the model to the job
